description: This file provides SwiftUI view extensions to construct UI sections related to channel settings, including actions for channels like WhatsApp and Telegram, configuration management, and UI layout helpers.

methods.name: formSection
methods.description: Creates a styled form section with a title and custom content.

methods.name: channelHeaderActions
methods.description: Provides UI buttons for channel actions like logout and refresh.

methods.name: whatsAppSection
methods.description: Constructs the UI section dedicated to WhatsApp linking and QR code display.

methods.name: genericChannelSection
methods.description: Creates a generic configuration section for given channel.

methods.name: configEditorSection
methods.description: Builds the configuration editing UI for a specific channel.

methods.name: configStatusMessage
methods.description: Displays the current status message of the configuration.
